messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick sync — final pre-launch checklist for the startup listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). Goal: greenlight packaging + legal + marketplace uploads by EOD tomorrow. Who can confirm SDK/AMI artifacts?

sam-eng: I can confirm the SDK bundles. Uploaded to gs://redwood-marketplace/staging/2026-03-22/ — includes mac/x86 builds and the wrapper scripts. Ran smoke tests: `python smoke_test.py --env=staging` passed 3/3.

omar-cloud: AWS side: need the final offer ID and the AMI ID. I have the account mapping. AMI is ready but tagging/ownership needs your acceptance, @anna-partnerships. AMI: `ami-0c1f2b3d4e5f6a7b8`

tess-legal: Sending the EULA + marketplace addendum draft now. Key open items: data residency clause (client requested EU-only), indemnity language for SI integrations, and trial duration wording. I put comments inline. Can someone confirm the EU-only requirement is necessary for the listing?

mike-product: EU-only for some customers, yes. For this initial listing we can offer EU-only trial region flag but global visibility for the product. Need to confirm entitlements mapping (trial vs paid).

leigh-marketing: Heads-up: co-marketing asset deadline Friday. We need a 1-line offer blurb + hero screenshot. If legal wants to delay wording, we can use a placeholder description but not the hero.

sam-eng: Noted on entitlements. I pushed the trial flag mapping to `terraform/marketplace/trial-mapping.tf` — snippet: ```resource "redwood_marketplace_entitlement" "trial" { sku = "RDWD-TRIAL-2026" duration_days = 14 }```

omar-cloud: For Azure we need publisher tenant details. @anna-partnerships can you confirm the publisher contact? Also GCP listing needs the valid service account email for billing entitlement.

anna-partnerships: Publisher contact is `pub-team@redwood.com` (cc'd via email). For GCP billing SA it's `marketplace-billing@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` — I'll confirm with infra.

tess-legal: Quick note on EULA: remove the phrase "unlimited tech support" — marketing can rephrase as "priority support for paid tiers". Also require redwood KMS note for private deployments.

mike-product: On packaging: we need clear trial UX — trial should auto-expire and convert via coupon code. Sam, can the SDK return a trial entitle header so the UI can show CTA?

sam-eng: Yes, SDK will return `X-Marketplace-Trial-Expires` header. I'll add tests.

deploy-bot: package-upload: marketplace-artifacts v1.6.2 uploaded to s3://marketplace-artifacts/redwood/v1.6.2 at 2026-03-22T15:12:08Z :package:

leigh-marketing: Can we coordinate announcement with the partners team? If listing goes live, want to schedule a short joint tweet + marketplace spotlight next week. Who owns the partner tweet copy?

anna-partnerships: I'll draft the partner tweet and send it for legal review. For decision: If legal signs off on addendum and AMI tags are approved by cloud, we can proceed with uploads tomorrow. Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is done so I can tally and confirm go/no-go.

sam-eng: :thumbsup: SDK bundles verified.

omar-cloud: :thumbsup: AMI tags queued, waiting on final acceptance from @anna-partnerships.

tess-legal: :thumbsup: EULA comments submitted, will mark accepted once Anna confirms data residency flag.

mike-product: :thumbsup: Entitlement mapping merged to staging.

anna-partnerships: Thanks all — I'll accept AMI tags and confirm the EU trial flag by 11:30 PT tomorrow. If anything blocks earlier, ping me directly.
